requirements.requirement: Retain original complete URI identities and reject ownership collisions.
Select exact upstream Git commits and explicit source, dependency and test files.
Preserve source bytes, Git executable modes, native metadata, entry points and license terms.
Use an explicit compatible package profile; reject unsupported formats.
Verify upstream identity, original behavior and installed distribution; preserve complete test identities.
Apply URIpack plans only through independently protected Guard; preserve uncertain outcomes without replay.
Publish using independent exact-head/current-base verification and authenticated merge evidence.
Require fresh deployment planning, current authority and independent production acceptance for cutover.
Pin adoption by immutable source revision and complete bundle digest; upgrades are explicit.
Add new profiles with schemas, representative sources and positive and negative conformance cases.

Rust URI-process packages (rust-uri-v1) MUST declare Cargo crate identity, dual-transport bindings (cdylib FFI and/or json-stdin-stdout binary), and a prioritized Python fallback chain (floor -> standard).

requirements.title: Universal polyglot uri() function and uri CLI JSONL invocation and lifecycle contract
requirements.description: Scripts and applications across languages (Python, Rust, Bash, JS/TS) invoke URI processes via uri('<scheme://authority/path[?k=v]>', [jsonl_payload]) or the uri CLI with JSON/JSONL payloads, supporting process generation, modification, and alias-preserving relocation in dockuri.
requirements.requirement: Provide a universal polyglot invocation contract (`uri('<full-uri>', payload)` library function and `uri <full-uri> '<jsonl>'` CLI command) backed by `uriprocess.invocation/v1` and `uriprocess.invocation-result/v1` JSONL envelopes and a prioritized resolver (`floor:in_process_registry` -> `standard:dockuri_router` -> `standard:dockuri_cli_jsonl`).

errors.URP-DATA-001: Malformed, duplicate-key or oversized input document.
errors.URP-SCHEMA-001: Input violates a supported package or provenance schema.
errors.URP-PATH-001: Unsafe path, symlink, special file or inventory limit.
errors.URP-INTEGRITY-001: Package file set, source digest or executable mode differs.
errors.URP-IDENTITY-001: URI or native package identity differs from its preserved contract.
errors.URP-TESTS-001: Required original tests are absent from provenance.
